描述_EN: the blessings of auspicious spiritual forces were sought; evil spirits were repelled through the medium of tile decoration. they were often identified as qin qiong and yuzhi gong, generals of the tang dynasty (618-907) famed in popular tradition for frightening away demons troubling the emperor taizong (reigned 626-649). in the various regions of china, different names were given to such figures. this heroic galloping celestial warrior is summoned to do battle with malign forces. this tile depicts a guardian figure. chinese builders incorporated roof ornamentation that symbolised the key position of the roof as the bridge supporting the movement of spirits between heaven and earth.
描述_ZN: the blessings of auspicious spiritual forces were sought; evil spirits were repelled through the medium of tile decoration. 他们通常被认为是秦琼和尉迟恭，唐朝（618-907）的将军，在民间传说中因吓走困扰太宗皇帝（626-649在位）的恶魔而闻名。 在中国的不同地区，这种人物被赋予了不同的名字。 这个英勇奔放的天体战士被召唤来与恶势力做斗争。 这块瓦片描绘了一个守护者的形象。 中国的建筑商将屋顶的装饰物纳入其中，象征着屋顶作为支持天地间精神运动的桥梁的关键地位。
